protocol.selection: Validation UAR; feature size from training-speaker CV
protocol.test_policy: Freeze both architectures and baselines before one cached test pass each
protocol.class_weights: Inverse training frequency, normalized to mean one
protocol.cv_schedule: Fixed StepLR, step_size=5, gamma=0.5; independent of evaluation metrics
protocol.cnn_padding: Valid-frame BatchNorm, masked convolutions and packed BiLSTM

noise_evaluation.power_window: Mono 16 kHz; first six seconds, including pauses
noise_evaluation.headroom: One common gain per recording across clean and all SNRs; peak at most 0.99
noise_evaluation.role: Frozen final models only; no model selection
